feature: Screen reader announces the added/removed file by name (EPMCDME-8561, WCAG 2.1 SC 4.1.3)
method: Announcements are read from the browser accessibility tree (role=status nodes), not from DOM textContent, because a region inside an aria-hidden/inert subtree still has text in the DOM while being invisible to assistive technology. The live region's ancestors are additionally scanned for aria-hidden/inert and for display/visibility.
flow: log in via /v1/local-auth/login, inject the codemie_access_token cookie, open #/data-sources, Create Datasource, set Datasource Type = File in the #indexType autocomplete, upload quarterly-report.pdf into input[aria-label='Select files to upload'], then remove it

before.build: main @ 1bf0010d79aa3b9fafd4b2e5e570609ddb7d417f, vite dev server on :5198 from a clean worktree
before.verdict: reproduces the ticket - the file name is never announced

after.verdict: fixed - the name reaches assistive technology

live_region.note: exactly one FilesDropzone status region; the second role=status node in the tree is the app's pre-existing toast

screenshot_note: The change is purely non-visual: the announcer is an sr-only region, so the before and after screenshots are deliberately identical. The behavioural proof is the accessibility-tree text above.
